worldcombat.attributes.title: Attributes
worldcombat.attributes.open_hint: View current values, sources and gameplay effects
worldcombat.attributes.heading: %1$s · Attributes
worldcombat.attributes.footer: Hover for effects and sources · Updates when values change
worldcombat.attributes.level.help: Native level. Growth affects moves through native stats; authored moves may also use level directly.
worldcombat.attributes.health.help: Remaining HP, read directly from the native individual.
worldcombat.attributes.max_health.help: The health capacity shared by world combat and the native summary.
worldcombat.attributes.atk.help: Cultivated native Attack. Used for physical damage and may drive meaningful effects such as force or carrying; inspect each move for its actual contribution.
worldcombat.attributes.def.help: Cultivated native Defense. Used for physical protection; the same native armor projection is counted only once.
worldcombat.attributes.spa.help: Cultivated native Special Attack. Used for special damage; other effects define their own relationships.
worldcombat.attributes.spd.help: Cultivated native Special Defense. Used for protection against special damage.
worldcombat.attributes.spe.help: Cultivated native Speed. Already contributes to companion navigation; moves may also use it for their timing.
worldcombat.attributes.friendship.help: Native friendship, retained by growth and evolution rules and available to authored interactions.
worldcombat.attributes.mass.help: Native form weight converted to kilograms for effects that use weight. This value alone imposes no movement restriction.
worldcombat.attributes.critical_chance.h: General critical chance including the active ability and held item. Move-specific critical stages and the target’s protection still affect the final result.
worldcombat.attributes.critical_multipli: Critical versus normal damage in the shared damage calculation, including the current ability.
worldcombat.attributes.skill_haste.help: Shared move cooldown uses original cooldown × 100 / (100 + haste). At 100 haste, cooldown is halved. Windup and recovery remain move-specific; custom formulas are explained in move details.
Percentage adjustment to move and held-item healing through the shared healing interface. +25%% turns 20 healing into 25; maximum HP still applies.
worldcombat.attributes.curiosity.help: Combines with native nature, equipment and authored AI to influence attention and exploration. Zero preserves the choices from those sources.
worldcombat.attributes.risk.help: Added to nature and equipment tendencies. Positive values favor staying with threats; negative values favor earlier retreat. Changes decisions, not damage resistance.
worldcombat.attributes.persistence.help: Changes the shared AI’s preference for continuing an action, alongside nature and task conditions. Does not lock behavior.
